title: generate-ux-pack input
description: Inputs for the generate-ux-pack skill: UX team's drop + BA brief. Skill emits a v1.1 UX-design intake pack consumed by Stage 2 TL Design and Stage 4b Frontend Implementation.

frontend_spec_path.description: Path to the Frontend Spec markdown (authoritative content source for brand, routes, components, business logic, recommended stack).

prototype_html_path.description: Path to the bundled prototype HTML. Structural reference only; do not extract text or style data from bundled code.

ba_brief_dir.description: Path to the BA brief output directory (contains output.json + epics/). Authoritative source for what stories exist.

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4 for run identity. First 8 chars become the {idem8} suffix on the output directory.

figma_url.description: Optional Figma source URL. If absent, emitted to README.md as TBD-fill-in.

ux_team_contact.description: Optional UX team contact. If absent, emitted to README.md as TBD-fill-in.

workload_tier.description: Workload tier override. T1 = banking/regulated, T2 = production/general, T3 = research/internal.
